note.value: An ordinary canvas/JS wallpaper — no browser engine. It reads these values from window.luminos.props and the spectrum from livelyAudioListener, the surface a Lively .js already expects. Qt draws canvas on the CPU, so this costs far more than a .frag shader does (measured: ~50% of a core here against 6.6% for the Shadertoy sample). Frames per second is the setting that moves that number — surface width barely does.
